scope: Short 32-token diagnostic traces, not sustained 512-token throughput. GPU decode markers only; cold misses change through the trace.

rows.scope: Diagnostic GPU kernel durations contained in GPU decode-forward annotation ranges; pending prefill and postprocessing excluded. CPU/GPU marker counts verified; only CPU count is denominator. GPU duration sums and union reported separately. CPU blocking waits overlap GPU work and are not an extra additive cost. This is not a long-output throughput benchmark.
